title: Antibody Conjugation and CODEX Multiplexed Immunofluorescence of Fresh Frozen Tissue
author: Elizabeth Neumann
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.buc5nsy6
materials: 50 kDa molecular weight cut off filters
Start with purified antibodies (no BSA, azides, glycerol, etc.). If BSA is present, remove with ab173231.

Reduce antibodies with the reduction mixture for 20-25 minutes at ~ 20 °C . 25 minutes of reduction is suitable for many antibodies but may need to be optimized (15 min-40 min) depending on the primary antibody used. In general, shorter reduction times are more appropriate than longer times.
Centrifuge the reduced antibodies at 12000 x g, °C, for 00:08:00 and add buffer solution.
Respective barcode solutions are added to the reduced primary antibodies and incubated for 02:00:00 at ~ 20 °C
Submerge tissues in excess acetone for 00:05:00 .

Dilute antibodies in reporter solution to a 1:200 dilution with 1 µL of a 1 mg/mL solution of DAPI or Hoechst 33342. Most secondary oligonucleotide barcode reporters function at a 1:200 dilution; however, this dilution may need to be optimized in select cases or with custom reagents.

steps.title: Block 50 kDa filters
steps.instruction: Block 50 kDa molecular weight cut‑off filters with 500 µL filter blocking solution.

steps.title: Centrifuge blocked filters
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the blocked filters at 12 000 × g, °C, for 2 min (00:02:00).

steps.title: Dilute and filter antibodies
steps.instruction: Dilute 50 µg of each antibody into 100 µL PBS, then filter using 50 kDa MWCO filters.

steps.title: Centrifuge antibody filtrate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12 000 × g, °C, for 8 min (00:08:00).

steps.title: Rehydrate oligo barcodes
steps.instruction: Rehydrate oligonucleotide barcodes in 10 µL nuclease‑free water, then add 210 µL conjugation solution (use nuclease‑free water to avoid degradation).

steps.title: Purify conjugate by buffer exchange
steps.instruction: Buffer‑exchange with 450 µL purification solution, centrifuge at 12 000 × g, °C, for 8 min (00:08:00), and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Prepare frozen tissue
steps.instruction: Remove fresh frozen tissue from –80 °C and place in a desiccator for 20 min (00:20:00).

steps.title: Rehydrate tissue
steps.instruction: Rehydrate tissues in hydration buffer for 3 min (00:03:00) inside a humidity chamber.

steps.title: Fix tissue in PFA
steps.instruction: Fix tissues for 10 min (00:10:00) in 1.6 % paraformaldehyde prepared in hydration buffer.

steps.title: Submerge in staining buffer
steps.instruction: Submerge tissues in excess staining buffer for 30 min (00:30:00).

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate tissues with blocking buffer and primary‑antibody cocktail (1:200 dilution) for 3 h (03:00:00) in a humidity chamber at ~20 °C; tissues may be incubated overnight at 4 °C if placed in a refrigerator (background may increase).

steps.title: Rinse and post‑fix
steps.instruction: Rinse samples with staining buffer, then fix with 1.6 % paraformaldehyde in storage buffer for 10 min (00:10:00).

steps.title: PBS rinse and methanol
steps.instruction: Rinse with excess PBS, incubate in cold methanol for 5 min (00:05:00), then rinse again with excess PBS.

steps.title: Final fixation before storage
steps.instruction: Fix the samples with fixative solution for 10 min (00:10:00) and store in storage buffer at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare CODEX reagents
steps.instruction: Fill respective bottles with nuclease‑free water, 1× CODEX buffer, and dimethyl sulfoxide.

steps.title: Mount blank coverslip
steps.instruction: Mount a blank coverslip into the microfluidic chamber and flush the fluidic lines.

steps.title: Mount tissue and DAPI stain
steps.instruction: Mount the prepared tissue sample, incubate with 1× CODEX buffer and 1 µL of 1 mg/mL DAPI for 5 min (00:05:00), then wash with the automated CODEX system.

steps.title: Define imaging tiles
steps.instruction: Set up tiled regions covering the tissue and focus at the tissue surface.

steps.title: Automated microscopy acquisition
steps.instruction: Perform automated microscopy using a Zeiss Axio (or equivalent) equipped with a Colibri 7 LED light source and C13440 camera; use 10 % tile overlap and a z‑stack of 11–20 tiles (depending on tissue size).

steps.title: Store stained tissue
steps.instruction: Store in 100 µL antibody storage solution at 4 °C.
